title: File conversation cross-instance CAS

commands.name: CodeAnalytics post snapshot and architecture queries

architectureChecks.name: CodeAnalytics pre/post
architectureChecks.evidence: snap-20260808151033-58716b78 -> snap-20260808151836-58716b78; no blocking errors or dependency cycle

architectureChecks.name: boundary ownership
architectureChecks.evidence: The coordinator is a top-level type in Llm.Conversations; Abstractions is unchanged

architectureChecks.name: bounded lifecycle
architectureChecks.evidence: Reference-counted entries retire, are removed by key/value identity, and dispose their semaphore at zero references

architectureChecks.name: guarantee scope
architectureChecks.evidence: The store explicitly documents process-wide coordination and does not claim cross-process safety

bugs: Each scoped file store previously owned its semaphore dictionary, so separate instances could pass the same revision check and race File.Move.

acceptance.criterion: Two store instances racing one revision admit exactly one winner.
Replace/delete race does not corrupt storage.
Injected failure/cancellation leaves no temp file.

residualRisk: Coordination is intentionally process-wide. Multiple OS processes must not write the same storage root.
